question: Which user has viewed the most offers without ever making a single booking?
golden_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(v.id) AS view_count FROM users u JOIN views v ON u.id = v.user_id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON u.id = b.requester_id WHERE b.id IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 1;
